newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas prices down with physical, trade picks.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas prices down with physical, trade picks.

text.p: The IPE natural gas futures contract continued its modest increase in volume on Tuesday afternoon as a further trade was done, taking the total for the day to 100 lots in five deals.

The price direction continued downwards in line with the physical market, with front month June trading at 10.95 pence a therm, down by 0.175 pence from Monday's settlement level. By the close June, July and August were all offered at 11.00 pence, in each case below the settlement level of the previous day.
With the exception of November and December, all offer prices were below the settlement levels, indicating that sellers are lowering their ideas in line with the lower prices seen on the OTC market.

And although the level of trade remained relatively thin - even though better than the minimal volumes seen last week - there was some hectic activity by players posting bids and offers. Especially in the last few minutes before the contract closed there was a rapid turnover of bids and offers, with reasonably tight ranges posted for most periods by the close.
